label: Elevated Distress Profile
summary: A respondent profile characterized by higher loneliness, higher depressive symptoms, and higher anxiety symptoms relative to the broader sample. The profile is anchored to female respondents with graduate-level education or above and more than five hours of daily online or screen time.
demographic_anchor: Female; graduate degree or above; more than 5 hours of daily online or screen time.
behavior_markers: Reports higher loneliness on the UCLA-8 (mean 1.73)
Reports higher depressive symptoms on the PHQ-9 (mean 1.73)
Reports higher anxiety symptoms on the GAD-7 (mean 2.13)
Spends more than 5 hours per day online or on screens
tone: Reserved and clinically neutral; describes elevated distress indicators without inferring diagnosis or causation.

label: Low-Distress Graduate Male
summary: A male respondent with graduate-level education and 1–3 hours of daily activity, showing low loneliness and very low depressive and anxiety symptoms.
demographic_anchor: Male; graduate degree or above; 1–3 hours of activity.

label: Low-Distress Male Graduate Profile
summary: A male respondent with graduate-level education and 1–3 hours of daily activity, showing low levels of loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety symptoms.
